title: Chapter 156 The Opportunity Of Defeat
content:
Chapter 156 The Opportunity Of Defeat

"Hurry up, hurry up, those cavalrymen behind are about to catch up, damn Yu Guoren, why are you running so fast!"

Riding on the steed, Yan Dan kept urging the cavalry around her, her eyes kept looking back.

Looking at the imperial knights behind him in blue and red army robes and gluttonous masks, gradually catching up to him with their better horses as time went by, he couldn't help feeling extremely anxious.

‘Damn it, can’t I really escape? '

As time slowly passed, the distance between the two armies has been less than two or three miles. It can almost be said that in just a while, the two armies will be close to each other.

That being the case, then: "Soldiers, since you have escaped, you can't escape, so let's fight to the death. Even if we lose, we must give these Yuguo people a miserable end, so that they will never forget this day!"

Turning the horse's head, Yan Dan rushed behind him.

The other soldiers of Yan State, seeing their commander's actions, also responded one after another, followed impassionedly, and killed Zhao Yun's troops behind them.

The riding speed was very fast, and within a few minutes, Zhao Yun and others collided with the Yan Dan army who had just turned their horses around.

The sound of rumbling horseshoes breaking, and the roar of the killing roared together quickly, taking away countless lives.

You come and go, the lances or sharp long swords in the hands of both sides stab gently towards each other. It doesn't take much strength, just a light touch, and then quickly close your hands, you can take away a Fresh life.

Those who really do the heavy lifting are some inexperienced rookies. All those who are good at riding and fighting know that when a horse charges, the impact and power it brings are unparalleled.

If you really use all your strength to stab your opponent unknowingly, then the random consequence is that you can definitely kill the enemy and knock it into the air, but you will also be carried away and float backward .

Therefore, an experienced knight will only control his horse with all his strength, control the direction well, so that he can sit on the horse and fall steadily, and then aim at the enemy. Gently touching him is enough to rely on The impact of his own horse caused fatal injuries to the enemy.

This battle is not only a place where the soldiers lay down their lives, but also a stage for the generals to show their bravery.

I saw Zhao Yun and others, relying on their skillful skills, waved the long spears in their hands like stars in the sky, lightly tapped on the enemy soldiers in front of them, stuck to them, and left without any mess.

The soldier who was targeted was clutching the stabbed wound, and slowly fell off the horse, and then was trampled into a puddle of mud by the passing horse's hooves.

Of course, there are also people who can be vicious on the battlefield by relying only on their own talent and supernatural power, not relying on their superb skills.

Just like Zhang Fei, he relied on his own brute strength and completely abandoned any skills, and as a first-class master, he already had enough methods for transporting power.

This was because he was not afraid of the impact force brought by the horses, so he directly waved the snake spear, picked up Yan soldiers one after another, and smashed them forward, and all the horse soldiers along the way were knocked down. Long marks were brought out, and the road in front of him was cleared a bit.

The 50,000 imperial cavalry, headed by five of their generals, broke through the dense sprints of Yan's cavalry, dispersed the Yan's cavalry, and then strangled and drowned them in the boundless cavalry group.

"Damn it, how dare the thieves bully me that Yan has no generals!"

Riding on his war horse and waving the long sword in his hand, Yan Dan is swaying his internal strength recklessly. Around him, within a few meters, there was no living person.

Those Yu soldiers who tried to approach him were either intercepted by Yan Dan's cavalry following him, or they were directly crushed to death by his first-class strength.

Yandan's surroundings became a death zone. Gradually, when other soldiers of the imperial kingdom saw him, they didn't take the initiative to walk towards him. Instead, they bypassed it and killed other ordinary soldiers of the Yan kingdom who they could deal with.

And Yan Dan finally got a chance to breathe, and had the opportunity to look around, what happened to his soldiers? Where is the situation on the battlefield?

But what he saw made him terrified, his eyes tearing apart. The soldiers under his command were easily defeated by those who defended the country, and fell off their horses.

Often two or three soldiers of the Yan Kingdom can be exchanged for one soldier of the Yu Kingdom, which can be said to be vulnerable. In just over ten minutes, the 30,000 Yan State cavalry has dropped by 10,000.

Moreover, under the leadership of the five generals of the enemy, they were quickly broken through, breaking up the charge formation of their own cavalry, forced to disperse, and could not gather enough strength.

On the other hand, those enemy cavalry were still gathered together, and after this fight, only two or three thousand people died, and nothing was injured at all. Even from the outside of the battlefield, there was no loss. .

It's definitely not going to work like this, what changes do I want to make? To restore the decline of this battlefield?

After thinking and thinking, Yan Dan sadly found that he couldn't do anything in his current situation, the only thing he could do was to use his strength to become a first-order master.

To block one of Zhao Yun's five generals, use them as the impact of arrows, drop them down, and block their fierce offensive for a while.

Yan Dan made a choice, and chose Zhang Fei, who did the most damage to the soldiers and had the deepest impact on morale, as his opponent.

He found that Zhang Fei did not kill the most soldiers, and he was not as fast and accurate as Zhao Yun.

However, Zhang Fei displayed his violent characteristics and went on a rampage. Every Yan soldier who touched his hands died terribly and bloody.

This method of killing is the most intuitive, and it has the strongest impact on the soldiers. It is no different from Zhao Yun and others. Killing has a sense of beauty. Those Yan soldiers even have a feeling that death by his hands is nothing.

But Zhang Fei was different. He was very vulgar and straightforward. When he hit him, his body was strewn all over the floor, and his brains flowed out.

Although for those soldiers, falling to the ground after death and being trampled into mud by horseshoes is not much better. But there is always a first-come first-come-first-served basis for things, direct and indirect distinctions, and differential treatment emerges.

Therefore, the cavalrymen of Yan Kingdom in front of them all retreated one after another, not daring to face him, and the sprint naturally slowed down, and the formation also dispersed.

The formation is chaotic and the strength is scattered, but the enemy still maintains a strong impact, concentrated strength, and high morale. The situation on the battlefield is naturally irreversible.
